risks.title: Competition in Payments and Pricing Pressure
risks.score_rationale: Global Payments faces intense competition from Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Block and bank-led ISOs. Take-rate compression and bundled software pricing pressure margins, as repeatedly cited in Item 1A.
risks.summary: Aggressive pricing and innovation by integrated payment competitors could erode merchant retention, take rates and operating margins.

risks.title: Reorganization and Worldpay Acquisition Execution
risks.score_rationale: GPN's 2025 acquisition of Worldpay (Merchant) and concurrent divestiture of Issuer Solutions to FIS is transformational, with material integration, leverage and execution risk.
risks.summary: The Worldpay integration and Issuer Solutions divestiture create material execution, integration and balance sheet risk during a multi-year transition.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Breach
risks.score_rationale: As a card payment processor, GPN handles vast volumes of cardholder data. PCI DSS, sponsorship bank obligations and ransomware exposure are material; breaches would trigger fines, fraud losses and customer attrition.
risks.summary: A cybersecurity breach or systems outage could trigger significant fines, fraud losses, brand damage and merchant attrition.

risks.title: Regulatory and Interchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interchange regulation (Durbin extensions, EU IFR, UK PSR), CFPB scrutiny of fees, and crypto/BNPL rules could reshape economics.
risks.summary: Regulatory caps on interchange or surcharging and increased oversight of merchant fees could compress revenue per transaction.

risks.title: Merchant Credit and Chargeback Risk
risks.score_rationale: Acquirers bear chargeback exposure if merchants fail to deliver. Recessionary stress and large-merchant failures (e.g. travel, ticketing) can produce material losses.
risks.summary: Merchant insolvencies in travel, retail and event sectors expose Global Payments to chargeback losses that may exceed reserves.

risks.title: Leverage and Refinancing Risk
risks.score_rationale: The Worldpay acquisition materially increases pro-forma leverage. Higher rates and integration cash needs constrain capital return and credit rating.
risks.summary: Elevated leverage post-Worldpay and higher refinancing costs could weigh on credit ratings and capital return capacity.

risks.title: FX and Emerging Markets Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Operations in LATAM, Central Europe and Asia create FX translation and political risk. EVO Payments integration adds emerging market exposure.
risks.summary: FX volatility and political/economic instability in international markets could impact reported revenue and require local capital injections.
